plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Coriant Groove transmission device. It reports uptime, system power consumption, shelf and card temperatures, card, fan and power supply status, fan speed, and interface traffic, for Coriant/Infinera Groove G30 platforms (enterprise PEN 42229).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_power_watts
metrics.description: This metric reports the current power consumption of the whole Groove network element in watts (systemPowerConsumptionCurrent, string value parsed to a number). Unexpected rises can indicate added load, fan over-speed or hardware faults.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports shelf inlet/outlet temperatures (shelfInletTemperature/shelfOutletTemperature) and per-card temperatures (cardTemperature) of the Groove device in degrees Celsius. Non-numeric readings are skipped.

metrics.name: device_card_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each provisioned card (cardOperStatus, raw up(1) / down(2)), normalized so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault. Empty slots have no card row and are not reported.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each FAN card (cardOperStatus of cards whose required type is fan), normalized so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: This metric reports the speed of each FAN card as a 0-100 percentage (cardFanSpeedRate).

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each PSU card (cardOperStatus of cards whose required type is psu), normalized so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
